p0.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi stainless steel slant ridge trowel lays adhesive in angled ridges instead of square ones. When you bed the tile the slanted ridges fold over and overlap, so the adhesive spreads into a solid layer with far fewer air pockets than a standard notch leaves. That means better coverage under large format tiles and less chance of water sitting under outdoor tiles. Choose a 6, 8 or 10 mm notch.

Use it for

  • Large format floor and wall tiles where full coverage matters
  • Outdoor tiling, balconies and wet areas

Features

  • Slanted notches that collapse and overlap when the tile is bedded
  • Stainless steel blade, 100 percent rust proof
  • Rubber handle on a die cast aluminium core

Specifications

  • Blade: 28 x 13 cm
  • Notch: 6, 8 or 10 mm
  • Raimondi lists the 8 mm as Art. 183HFV8 and the 10 mm as Art. 183HFV10
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Comb all the ridges in one direction, then set the tile with a slight push across the ridges to collapse them.
  • Lift the first tile to check coverage. You should see almost no ridge lines.
  • The long bladed version is listed separately for faster spreading.

p1.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi long bladed slant ridge trowel gives you the coverage of a slant ridge notch on a longer blade, so you spread adhesive under large format tiles faster. The slanted ridges fold over and overlap when the tile is bedded, filling the back of the tile with far fewer air pockets than a square notch, which also means less water sitting under tiles outdoors. Choose a 6, 8 or 10 mm notch.

Use it for

  • Spreading adhesive under large format tiles and slabs
  • Big floors where a standard 28 cm trowel is slow
  • Outdoor tiling and wet areas

Features

  • Slanted notches that collapse and overlap when the tile is bedded
  • Long blade for more adhesive per pass
  • Stainless steel, 100 percent rust proof
  • Rubber handle on a die cast aluminium core

Specifications

  • Notch: 6, 8 or 10 mm
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Comb all the ridges in one direction and set the tile with a slight push across them so they collapse fully.
  • Lift the first tile to check coverage before you lay the rest.
  • The standard 28 x 13 cm slant ridge trowel is listed separately for smaller tiles.

p2.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi double foam rubber squeegee pulls grout water and slurry off a floor in one pass. Two layers of foam rubber hold far more liquid than a single blade, so you clear a wet floor quickly after grouting or washing down, and the foam is replaceable when it wears. Choose 400, 500 or 750 mm wide. Handle not included.

Use it for

  • Clearing grout wash water and slurry from floors
  • Removing water before sealing or cleaning
  • Spreading grout slurry on floors with wide joints

Features

  • Double foam rubber gathers more liquid in each pass
  • Flexible, impact resistant body
  • Replaceable foam rubber
  • 26 mm handle socket

Specifications

  • Widths: 400 mm (Raimondi Art. 139 40), 500 mm (Art. 139) or 750 mm (Art. 140)
  • Weight: about 400, 500 and 600 g
  • Stainless steel versions also made by Raimondi
  • Made in Italy

Fits

  • Raimondi aluminium handles, and the matching spare double foam rubber in 40, 50 or 75 cm

Good to know

  • Rinse the foam after each use so grout does not harden in it.
  • Change the foam when the edge rounds over or it will leave streaks of grout water behind.

p3.descriptionHtml:
Standard Avana (brown) sponge roller for the Raimondi Berta and Rosina grout clean-up machines. It is the roller Raimondi makes for cement based grout: medium absorption, so it lifts the haze and slurry off the tile without sucking the grout back out of the joints. Fit a fresh one when the old roller goes hard or starts leaving streaks.

Fits

  • Raimondi Berta and Rosina grout clean-up machines (295 x 400 mm roller)

Specifications

  • Roller size: 295 x 400 mm
  • Avana (Havana) sponge, for cement based grout
  • Model: 380RULLO
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • The Berta ADV cleans around 100 m2 an hour and does not empty the joints. Roller life runs from about 150 to 2000 m2 depending on how rough the tile is.
  • For epoxy grout fit the cellulose roller; for faster work on cement grout the high absorption Sweepex roller.
  • Add Raimondi anti foam liquid to the water when cleaning latex modified grouts.
  • Rinse the roller and hang it to dry after each job.

p4.descriptionHtml:
Cellulose sponge roller for the Raimondi Berta and Rosina grout clean-up machines, made for epoxy and resin based grouts. Epoxy residue is sticky and ordinary sponge smears it around, so Raimondi uses natural cellulose, which lifts the emulsified epoxy off the tile and rinses clean in the machine's water tray. Swap it in for every epoxy job.

Fits

  • Raimondi Berta and Rosina grout clean-up machines (295 x 400 mm roller)

Specifications

  • Roller size: 295 x 400 mm
  • Cellulose sponge, for epoxy and resin based grout
  • Model: 380RULEPO
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Work within the grout maker's clean up window. Once epoxy cures it needs a chemical remover, not a sponge.
  • Emulsify the residue first with an abrasive pad or sponge, then run the Berta to lift it.
  • Keep this roller for epoxy and use the Avana or Sweepex rollers for cement grout.
  • Rinse thoroughly and hang to dry after each job.

p5.descriptionHtml:
Sweepex sponge roller for the Raimondi Berta and Rosina grout clean-up machines. Sweepex is Raimondi's very high absorption sponge, so this roller picks up more grout water per pass than the standard Avana roller and lasts longer before it needs replacing, which is why it is the one to fit for big commercial floors in cement based grout.

Fits

  • Raimondi Berta and Rosina grout clean-up machines (295 x 400 mm roller)

Specifications

  • Roller size: 295 x 400 mm
  • Sweepex sponge, very high absorption, for cement based grout
  • Model: 380RULSWE
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • The Berta ADV cleans around 100 m2 an hour without emptying the joints. A higher absorption roller means fewer stops to wring and refill.
  • Not for epoxy grout. Fit the cellulose roller for that.
  • Add Raimondi anti foam liquid to the water when cleaning latex modified grouts.
  • Rinse the roller and hang it to dry after each job.

p6.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi anti foam liquid for the Berta and Rosina grout clean-up machines. Modern polymer modified grouts foam up when the sponge roller churns the wash water, and the foam stops the roller rinsing properly and leaves a film on the tile. A few millilitres in the tray kills the foam so the machine keeps lifting clean water onto the roller.

Fits

  • Raimondi Berta and Rosina grout clean-up machines

Use it for

  • Cleaning latex and polymer modified cement grouts with a sponge roller machine

Specifications

  • Dose: 5 ml per litre of water
  • Sizes: 100 g or 400 g bottle
  • Raimondi anti foaming liquid, Art. 380ANTISC series

Good to know

  • A 100 g bottle treats about 20 litres of wash water, enough for a few tray fills on the Berta.
  • Add it to the tray before you start rather than once the foam has built up.
  • Change the water when it gets heavy with grout. Anti foam does not stop the water carrying grout back onto the tile.

p7.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi 1330 mm anodised aluminium handle for the pole tools in the range. One handle fits the sponge floats, foam rubber squeegees, gauging rake, screed spreader and broom head, so you carry a single pole and swap heads. The anodised aluminium is light, will not rust, and has a little flex that takes the shock out of a long day of sweeping and screeding.

Fits

  • Raimondi 13 x 42 cm pole sponge floats (as used with the Pedalo)
  • Raimondi double foam rubber squeegees
  • Raimondi self levelling gauging rake and screed spreader
  • Raimondi Battista broom head

Specifications

  • Length: 133 cm
  • Diameter: 27 mm
  • Anodised aluminium, without hole
  • Weight: about 420 g
  • Model: 197
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Raimondi also makes a two piece sectional 133 cm handle that packs into the van, and a 178 cm handle for tall users and big floors.
  • Push the head on firmly and rinse the socket so grout does not glue them together.
